items.summary: Enable simple inline click-to-expand behavior for images rendered in the public media gallery (attachments) so that clicking an image toggles between its normal card view and an expanded, larger inline view on the same page (no overlay/lightbox).

Enable simple inline click-to-expand behavior for images shown in the admin post editor media attachment list so that clicking an image preview toggles between the current preview size and an expanded inline view (no overlay/lightbox).

Ensure the admin media uploader provides a clearly visible, explicit upload-complete indication after a successful upload, and that the completion state is easy to notice and does not disappear too quickly for the owner to confidently avoid duplicate uploads.
